name: web_search
description: Searches the web for current information on a topic.

name: whois_lookup
description: Performs a WHOIS lookup for a domain. Returns registrar, registration/expiry dates, nameservers, and registrant info when available. Use this for passive reconnaissance once a target domain is known.

domain.description: The domain to look up, e.g. 'example.com' (no scheme, no path)

name: dns_lookup
description: Performs DNS enumeration on a domain. Queries A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, and CNAME records by default. Use this for active DNS enumeration after identifying a target domain.

domain.description: The domain to enumerate, e.g. 'example.com' (no scheme, no path)

record_types.description: Optional list of record types to query. Defaults to ['A','AAAA','MX','NS','TXT','SOA','CNAME']. Valid types include any DNS RR type supported by dnspython (e.g. CAA, SRV, PTR, DNSKEY).

name: subdomain_enum
description: Enumerates subdomains for a target domain by querying crt.sh (certificate transparency logs). Returns a deduplicated, sorted list. Passive reconnaissance — no traffic to the target.

limit.description: Optional max number of subdomains to return (default 100)

name: http_fingerprint
description: Performs HTTP fingerprinting on a URL or domain. Returns status, server, technology hints (X-Powered-By, Set-Cookie patterns), security headers, redirect chain, and the page title. Useful for tech-stack identification.

target.description: URL or bare domain (https:// is added automatically if missing)

name: port_scan
description: Async TCP port scan with optional banner grab. ACTIVE reconnaissance — sends real packets to the target. Defaults to the nmap top-100 TCP ports. Only use against hosts you have explicit permission to test.

host.description: Hostname or IP to scan. Hostnames are resolved via system DNS.

ports.description: Optional explicit port list. If omitted, scans the nmap top-100 TCP ports.

banner.description: Attempt a tiny banner read on open ports (default true)

name: write_file
description: Writes content to a file in the output directory.

file_path.description: File path relative to the output directory
